title: Adaptive evidence crediting and response orchestration for large enterprise contracts
creator: Ava Nguyen
description:
Background: Large enterprise contracts frequently require long security questionnaires (SIG / CAIQ / custom RFPs). Responding is labor-intensive and often blocks deal cycles. Current attestation bundles are rigid: customers either get a full evidence pack (high effort, high cost) or a minimal self-attestation (fast, lower trust).

Goal: Prototype an adaptive orchestration that (1) automatically generates a prioritized response bundle (evidence + authored answers) tailored to a customer’s questionnaire complexity and risk profile, and (2) ties that output to an experiment where customers receive an evidence credit (discount) proportional to the manual effort saved. We want to reduce average time-to-contract, surface repeatable answer templates for Sales/Legal, and measure the revenue uplift vs. cost of credits.

Success metrics (first 3 months):
- Reduce median questionnaire turnaround time from 14 days to <= 5 days for qualified deals.
- Increase % of deals closed within 30 days by +8% where an adaptive bundle was used.
- Maintain or improve NPS on security review interactions.
- Keep net cost of credits to <3% of ARR influenced by the experiment.

Scope of prototype:
- Input: customer questionnaire (SIG / CAIQ / custom CSV).
- Output: prioritized list of answers with attached evidence artifacts, a scoring of residual manual effort, and a recommended credit tier.
- Controls: manual override by Solutions Engineer; opt-in pricing experiment flag per account.

Implementation plan:
1) Designer & PM create a lightweight response template and UI flow in Console for Solutions Engineers to review and approve (mockups in Drive).
2) Build an orchestration service that: parses questionnaires, maps to canonical answers (answers datastore), pulls evidence artifacts from knowledge repo, and computes an effort score (heuristic: unanswered questions + non-evidence-backed answers).
3) Integrate with billing to attach a one-time evidence credit coupon tied to the deal.
4) Run an A/B experiment: 50% of qualified inbound enterprise trials get adaptive bundle + credit offer; control gets current manual process.

Trade-offs & risks:
- Automation mistakes could produce incorrect security answers; mitigated by human-in-the-loop approval.
- Credits may be gamed by customers requesting unnecessary artifacts; mitigate with eligibility rules and SE sign-off.
- Operational cost to curate evidence artifacts may be higher than estimated; track curator hours and adjust credit tiers.

Acceptance criteria:
- Console flow for SE review is functional and passes a security checklist.
- Orchestration can parse 90% of incoming SIG/CAIQs without manual mapping.
- Experiment telemetry instrumented: time-to-complete, deal outcome, credit redemption, manual hours saved.

Stakeholders: Sales (Maya Patel), Legal (Diego Ramos), Solutions Engineering (Priya Sharma), Security (Elena Koval), Billing (Omar Rivera), Engineering leads (Marcus Lee, Sophie Tran).

Reporting & follow-ups: Weekly cohort reports, with dashboards for time-to-contract and credit cost burn rate. Decision gate at 12 weeks to sunset, iterate, or scale.
